scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:build && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --pass-with-no-tests
